scope: Concrete technical or rendered-layout defects fixed during R7 production. This record does not claim story quality, physical printing or field testing.

corrections.finding: Player-kit page 11 content extended into the footer at initial layout, by 51px in Chinese and 72px in English.
corrections.fix: Reduced only the memorial reference illustration on the timeline work page to 100mm. All original choices and rules retained.
corrections.validation: Both final 43-page HTML geometries and actual PDFs pass.

corrections.finding: Closed HTML details hid their contents in Chromium print despite styling the body visible.
corrections.fix: Screen hints remain folded details; print uses a separate print-only copy of the same authored text.
corrections.validation: Sixteen print blocks per language visible, including share calibration. All fifteen actual hint strings per language found in final PDF text; hint pages visually inspected.

corrections.finding: CJK-first font fallback made English SVG possessive apostrophes appear unusually spaced.
corrections.fix: English original story diagrams use DejaVu Sans first and CJK fallback. Frozen puzzle figures unchanged.
corrections.validation: Independent English PDF reviewer inspected all 17 affected pages; page 10 possessives render normally.

corrections.finding: Storyboard explanatory labels slightly overlapped illustrated table legs in the cut and uncut figures.
corrections.fix: Shortened decorative table legs, moved cut explanation beneath the panels, and separated uncut labels from table legs.
corrections.validation: Final changed pages 1, 4, 36 and 37 independently rechecked in both languages. No unresolved collision.

corrections.finding: Prior R6 flow exposed ending directions while preparing materials and viewing early ending scenes.
corrections.fix: R7 preparation omits ending read/cut actions; midgame choices are separate; souvenir follows final scenes; digital receipt opens only on explicit request.
corrections.validation: Current bilingual narrative/UI checks pass, including all six default-closed receipt states.
